# τ₀-VLA: a Hierarchical Robot Foundation Model with World-Model-Guided Test-Time Computation     This repo is the official implementation of **τ₀-VLA: a Hierarchical Robot Foundation Model with World-Model-Guided Test-Time Computation**. ## News - **[2026.07.27]** 🚀 We release the **τ₀-VLA** model [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16885), [Project Website](https://tau0-vla.github.io/), and [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/sii-research/tau-0-vla). - **[2026.08.19]** 📢 We plan to progressively release components of the high-level policy. Please stay tuned for updates. ## Overview τ₀-VLA is a hierarchical robot foundation model for long-horizon manipulation. A memory-augmented high-level policy generates the next subtask and uses world-model-guided test-time computation to search over alternatives when additional reasoning is needed. A generalist low-level policy then executes the selected subtask across robot embodiments. The low-level policy combines a Qwen3.5 vision-language backbone with a Mixture-of-Transformers action expert trained through conditional flow matching. It uses a unified 40-dimensional state/action space and was trained on 40,115 hours of heterogeneous real-world robot data with multimodal co-training. ## Installation The reference environment uses Python 3.11, CUDA 12.8, and PyTorch 2.7.1. ## Example data and post-training [`example_data/`](example_data/README.md) contains a small AgiBot World subset in LeRobot v3.0 format. The matching post-training recipe is under [`configs/example_agibot_world_gong/`](configs/example_agibot_world_gong/README.md). For another dataset or robot, start from [`configs/_template/`](configs/_template/README.md) and [`src/tau0_vla/adapters/_template/`](src/tau0_vla/adapters/_template/README.md). ## Serving and evaluation Public v1 serving supports joint-control checkpoints only. abstract_zh: 本仓库是“τ₀-VLA：一个具有世界模型引导测试时计算的分层机器人基础模型”的官方实现。τ₀-VLA是一个用于长时程操作任务的分层机器人基础模型。其高层策略具有记忆增强功能，能够生成下一个子任务，并在需要额外推理时，利用世界模型引导的测试时计算来搜索替代方案。随后，一个通用的低层策略跨机器人本体执行所选子任务。低层策略结合了Qwen3.5视觉语言骨干网络和通过条件流匹配训练的混合Transformer动作专家。它使用统一的40维状态/动作空间，并在40,115小时异构真实世界机器人数据上进行了多模态协同训练。
tldr_zh: τ₀-VLA是分层机器人基础模型，用世界模型引导测试时计算，提升长时程操作能力。
cover_zh: 机器人也能“深思熟虑”？这个新模型用世界模型引导推理，长时程操作稳了！
